name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sensor
manufacturer: Generic (original design commonly attributed to Elecfreaks; sold by SparkFun as SEN-15569)
description: 40 kHz ultrasonic rangefinder module with separate transmit and receive transducers and a trigger/echo pulse interface.

specs.label: Supply
specs.value: 5 V DC (SEN-15569); 3.3–5 V for the HC-SR04-33 variant (SEN-24049)

specs.label: Range
specs.value: 2 cm – 4 m, accuracy up to 3 mm

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: Trig: 10 µs TTL pulse in; Echo: TTL pulse width ∝ distance (µs / 58 = cm); 4-pin 0.1" header VCC, Trig, Echo, GND

specs.label: Ultrasonic frequency
specs.value: 40 kHz burst (8 cycles); datasheet's 'Working Frequency 40 Hz' is the max measurement rate

envelope.axes: x = board length, y = board height, z = depth from PCB back to transducer front (datasheet '45*20*15mm')

features.label: Overall
features.source: https://cdn.sparkfun.com/datasheets/Sensors/Proximity/HCSR04.pdf p.1 (Elecfreaks datasheet linked by SparkFun SEN-15569)

features.label: Mounting holes
features.value: 4 corner holes; 40 mm center-to-center along the length (Cytron drawing). Hole diameter and vertical pitch are not given in any manufacturer-grade source.
features.source: Cytron 'Product User's Manual – HC-SR04' v1.0 (May 2013), Section 3.0 Product Layout drawing, p.5: https://embedded.fel.cvut.cz/sites/default/files/kurzy/lpe/ultrasonic_hc-sr04/HCSR04_DS_Cytron.pdf

features.label: Board length (conflict)
features.value: Cytron side view shows 43 mm; Elecfreaks/SparkFun text says 45 mm
features.source: Cytron manual p.5 vs SparkFun-hosted datasheet p.1

features.label: Transducers
features.source: No official diameter/pitch found. Unofficial: ~16 mm diameter cans ~26 mm apart (bracket makers), ~25.4 mm in a Thingiverse mount — not authoritative

features.label: Header
features.value: 4-pin 0.1" (2.54 mm) right-angle or straight header centered on the bottom edge, between the transducers
features.source: Cytron manual p.5 photo/drawing (positions not dimensioned)

amazon.title: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Distance Measuring Sensor Module

notes: There is no single manufacturer and no official 3D model or fully dimensioned drawing. SparkFun's SEN-15569 page publishes only the Elecfreaks datasheet (45 × 20 × 15 mm, no hole positions) and an example-code GitHub repo (no CAD). The best drawing found is Cytron's user manual (43 mm length in side view, 40 mm hole spacing, 20 mm height, 15 mm depth). Hole diameter (forum measurements ~2.2 mm, others say 1 mm/M1 or 3 mm), vertical hole pitch and transducer pitch are unverified — a human should caliper a real board before designing a tight mount. Clones vary. Amazon: no SparkFun-branded SEN-15569 listing found; B00F167T2A is a generic niceEshop HC-SR04 module (title verified). Downloaded: HCSR04-sparkfun-datasheet.pdf, HC-SR04-33_Datasheet.pdf, cytron.pdf.
